From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@reveriefin.com>

Cc: Marco Silva <marco.silva@reveriefin.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Reverie Financial — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today — helpful stuff. Quick recap from our side to make sure we’re aligned on what we discussed: 

- Primary pain: inference cost and inconsistent latency for our customer-facing workflows (document summarization + realtime Q&A).
- Current baseline: average latency ~450ms, p99 spikes near ~1.2s; cost per 1k tokens is higher than our projection.
- Compliance: need evidence of request-level audit logs and egress controls; data residency in US-only cloud region.
- Success metrics we care about: reduce per-request cost by ~3x (or lower TCO), p99 <= 200ms for short responses (<= 256 tokens), and end-to-end stack readiness to support 10k requests/day during the pilot.

We’re open to a short, focused pilot to validate latency and cost claims. Before we can commit, legal will want to see a short statement of data handling + any vendor security questionnaire responses. I’m attaching the call recording and will push a small de-id sample dataset to your SFTP by tomorrow.

Couple of Qs:
1) Can Redwood run an isolated pilot in a dedicated tenant (or VPC) with logging we can audit?
2) What minimal access do you need from our side to bootstrap the pilot (service account, dataset format, firewall allowlist)?
3) Can you share a proposed kickoff date window next week?

Thanks — happy to get a kickoff scheduled once we have those answers.

— Lena Ortiz
Director, Product 
Reverie Financial

Attachments: discovery-call-recording-20270216.mp3 (audio)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@reveriefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Reverie Financial — follow-up from discovery call

Hi Lena — great meeting, and thanks for the clear notes. I summarized the call and sketched a concise pilot plan below so everyone has the same reference.

Short recap (we heard):
- Target apps: document summarization + short-form Q&A in the product UI.
- Constraints: US-only residency, audit logs, spike protection.
- Goals: cost reduction (~3x target), p99 <= 200ms for <=256-token responses, validate throughput at 10k reqs/day.

Proposed pilot (4 weeks) — scope and deliverables:
- Scope: 4-week POC in a dedicated Redwood tenant (hosted Dedicated or Private with US region). 1 model variant for initial run (opt-quantized small-medium), live traffic replay + synthetic ramp.
- Metrics we will measure: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens per second, cost per 1k tokens, KV-cache hit rate, and correctness on a 50-sample prompt set (you’ll provide labels).
- Success criteria: p99 <= 200ms on 90% of steady-state windows, end-to-end cost <= target OR a clear roadmap to hit it via quantization/batching.
- Owners: Lena (Reverie product) — success sign-off; Naomi (Redwood Ops) — pilot engineer lead; Ben (Redwood Sales) — commercial lead and procurement liaison.
- Access & onboarding asks from Redwood:
  * Service account with read-only access to the sample dataset (SFTP or secure upload link).
  * Short engineer contact (name + email) for firewall allow-listing and token exchange.
  * Completed vendor security questionnaire (if you prefer, we can push a short bespoke one).
- Kickoff timeline (proposal): kickoff call week of Feb 22 with a 4-week active validation window starting Feb 23 (weekdays).

Deliverables we’ll share during pilot:
- Weekly telemetry dashboard (latency / cost / cache hits).
- Prompt set evaluation report (quality + regression checks).
- End-of-pilot economic model and recommended next steps (quantization, batching, routing).

Attached I’ve dropped a short mutual action plan (stub) — I’ll update it once we lock dates and the legal contacts. Can you confirm:
1) Are you able to provide the de-id sample dataset and the engineer contact by EOD tomorrow?
2) Does the proposed kickoff week of Feb 22 work?
3) Will legal want a vendor contract or a short MSA addendum for pilot-level activity?

If it’s easier, I can book a 30m kickoff slot — propose Feb 22, 10:00–10:30 PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-mutual-action-plan-REVERIE.docx (doc)
